defaultFee.title: Delivery fee where no zone matches
defaultFee.description: In minor units of your currency.

defaultFreeOver.title: Free delivery over (where no zone matches)
defaultFreeOver.description: Orders worth at least this much (after discounts, in minor units) are delivered free. 0 = never free.

pickupEnabled.title: Store pickup
pickupEnabled.description: Offer pickup at one point (without Multi-location stock; with it, pickup locations are used).

deliveryNote.title: Delivery time text
deliveryNote.description: Shown with delivery in the cart and on orders, for example "2–4 working days".

prepNote.title: Preparation text
prepNote.description: Shown in the cart and on orders, for example "Orders are packed within 24 hours".

pickupReadyNote.title: Pickup ready text
pickupReadyNote.description: Shown on orders for pickup, for example "We message you when it is ready".
